title: Omnigraph
lede: Omnigraph is an open-source graph database that lives in your own object storage and lets several AI agents write to one shared, typed graph without overwriting each other.

points: Each agent writes on its own branch, and changes are reviewed and merged into main, Git-style.
A typed ontology defines what can exist; writes that do not fit the schema are refused.
Semantic, keyword and hybrid search combine with graph traversal in a single query.
History is kept, so you can see who changed what and query the graph as it stood earlier.
Data sits as open files in any S3-compatible bucket, and permissions for agents and humans are defined in code.

sections.text: Teams running several agents over the same company data, for uses the launch comment lists such as a company knowledge graph or research graphs of papers and claims.
The code is open source under the MIT licence and runs on storage you supply, with no hosted memory API required.
